name: materials-studio-mcp
description: Local Materials Studio MCP server and safety-first modeling workflow for Windows.

interface.longDescription: Runs the versioned local Python Materials Studio MCP runtime and guides preview-first, revision-bound modeling, diagnostics, verified-window GUI synchronization, and guarded calculation preparation on Windows.
capabilities: Inspect local MCP, runner, project, and GUI status
Preview revisioned Materials Studio model changes
Operate only a verified Materials Studio window
Hot-load revisions through a signed same-window GUI loop
Preview guarded CASTEP, Forcite, and DMol3 workflows
defaultPrompt: Check the local Materials Studio MCP server and runner status; report blockers without changing anything.
Preview creating a semiconductor structure; inspect the current model and export multi-view diagnostics; do not execute.
Preview a patch to the current model and a CASTEP Energy workflow; execute neither.
